create_email_client_app: create an EmailClientApp instance to manage emails across INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, and TRASH folders
send_email: send an email to recipients with optional subject, content, CC, and file attachments
reply_to_email: reply to an existing email by ID with new content and optional attachments
search_emails: search emails in a folder by query string matching sender, recipients, subject, or content
download_attachments: download all attachments from an email by ID to a specified directory path
